Public contract
{
  "QuadraticEqualLengthRayPathMinimumSolver": {
    "capability_id": "angle_sum_equal_angle_candidates",
    "title": "由角和条件寻找等角",
    "use_when": "当题面给出两个角之和为 45°，且 angle_terms 的结构能够确定一个非退化的坐标轴等腰直角参考三角形时，消去公共角并输出 AngleEquality。只需提供结构化角和条件；水平轴点、竖直轴点、参考点和原点由代码从角的顶点顺序确定。点坐标可以含未定参数，只要坐标轴关系与等腰关系能够被符号恒等验证；无需先求出参数。本能力只推出等角事实，不计算目标点坐标。",
    "args": [
      {
        "name": "condition",
        "domain_type": "Fact",
        "required": true,
        "cardinality": "one",
        "fact_types": [
          "angle_sum"
        ]
      }
    ],
    "returns": [
      {
        "name": "angle_equality",
        "type": "AngleEquality",
        "binding": "call_result_or_answer_or_existing_object"
      }
    ],
    "do_not_use_when": [
      "角和不是 45°，或两个角的点顺序不能构成所需的坐标轴参考三角形。",
      "坐标轴关系或等腰关系只在某个尚未求出的参数值下成立，而不是符号恒等时。",
      "不要手工交换水平轴点、竖直轴点、参考点和原点；这些机械角色由结构化 angle_terms 决定。",
      "目标是直接求坐标时不能跳过等角事实的后续消费能力。"
    ]
  }
}
Method / Recipe Spec
{
  "method_id": "angle_sum_equal_angle_candidates",
  "title": "由角和条件寻找等角",
  "description": "由角和条件寻找唯一可用的等角关系。",
  "summary": "当题面给出两个角之和为 45°，且 angle_terms 的结构能够确定一个非退化的坐标轴等腰直角参考三角形时，消去公共角并输出 AngleEquality。只需提供结构化角和条件；水平轴点、竖直轴点、参考点和原点由代码从角的顶点顺序确定。点坐标可以含未定参数，只要坐标轴关系与等腰关系能够被符号恒等验证；无需先求出参数。本能力只推出等角事实，不计算目标点坐标。",
  "solves": [
    "derive_equal_angle_from_angle_sum"
  ],

    "目标是直接求坐标时不能跳过等角事实的后续消费能力。"

      [
        "∴",
        "Rt△COB 为等腰直角三角形，所以 ∠CBO＝45°"

      [
        "∵",

      ],
      [
        "∴",
        "两式消去公共角 ∠CBE，得 ∠OBE＝∠ACO"
      ]
    ],
    "box": [
      "∠OBE＝∠ACO"
    ],
    "unit_key": "angle_sum_equal_angle_candidates/derive_equal_angle"
  }
]

Public contract
{
  "QuadraticEqualLengthRayPathMinimumSolver": {
    "capability_id": "axis_intercept_from_equal_acute_angles",
    "title": "由等锐角求轴上截点",
    "use_when": "消费前序 AngleEquality，通过两个非退化直角三角形的正切比相等，求目标直线与竖直轴的辅助交点。只需提供等角事实；目标水平轴点、参考水平轴点、竖直轴点和原点由代码从等角两边的点顺序恢复。这些点可以携带符号坐标，输出也可以是待后续约束闭合的参数化 Point。本能力只计算轴截点，不证明该点在抛物线上，也不返回直线与抛物线的另一个交点；若最终目标是曲线点，还必须继续使用直线与抛物线交点能力。",
    "args": [
      {
        "name": "angle_equality",
        "domain_type": "Fact",
        "required": true,
        "cardinality": "one"
      }
    ],
    "returns": [
      {
        "name": "point",
        "type": "Point",
        "binding": "call_result_or_answer_or_existing_object",
        "desc": "坐标仍含未确定符号时为 open_state；不存在自由符号时为 closed_state。重复写入同一对象时，代码会验证它是否为状态收敛。",
        "return_expectation_policy": "selectable",
        "possible_forms": [
          "open_state",
          "closed_state"
        ]
      }
    ],
    "do_not_use_when": [
      "只有原始角和条件、尚未得到 AngleEquality 时，不能直接使用本能力。",
      "等角两边不能形成两个非退化直角三角形，或目标不是竖直轴截点。",
      "最终答案是抛物线上的曲线点时，不要把本能力的辅助轴截点直接绑定为该答案。",
      "不要手工交换目标水平轴点、参考水平轴点、竖直轴点和原点；这些机械角色由 AngleEquality 决定。"
    ]
  }
}
Method / Recipe Spec
{
  "method_id": "axis_intercept_from_equal_acute_angles",
  "title": "由等锐角求轴上截点",
  "description": "由两个锐角相等推出正切比相等，并求竖直轴截点。",
  "summary": "消费前序 AngleEquality，通过两个非退化直角三角形的正切比相等，求目标直线与竖直轴的辅助交点。只需提供等角事实；目标水平轴点、参考水平轴点、竖直轴点和原点由代码从等角两边的点顺序恢复。这些点可以携带符号坐标，输出也可以是待后续约束闭合的参数化 Point。本能力只计算轴截点，不证明该点在抛物线上，也不返回直线与抛物线的另一个交点；若最终目标是曲线点，还必须继续使用直线与抛物线交点能力。",
  "solves": [
    "derive_axis_intercept_from_equal_acute_angles"
  ],
  "inputs": {
    "angle_equality": {
      "required": true,
      "domain_type": "Fact",
      "runtime_type": "AngleEquality",
      "view": {
        "mode": "exact_result",
        "domain_type": "Fact"
      }
    },
    "x_axis_point": {
      "required": true,
      "domain_type": "Point",
      "runtime_type": "Point",
      "view": {
        "mode": "latest_state",
        "domain_type": "Point",
        "object_kind": "point",
        "state_kind": "coordinate"
      }
    },
    "y_axis_point": {
      "required": true,
      "domain_type": "Point",
      "runtime_type": "Point",
      "view": {
        "mode": "latest_state",
        "domain_type": "Point",
        "object_kind": "point",
        "state_kind": "coordinate"
      }
    },
    "reference_x_axis_point": {
      "required": true,
      "domain_type": "Point",
      "runtime_type": "Point",
      "view": {
        "mode": "latest_state",
        "domain_type": "Point",
        "object_kind": "point",
        "state_kind": "coordinate"
      }
    },
    "origin": {
      "required": true,
      "domain_type": "Point",
      "runtime_type": "Point",
      "view": {
        "mode": "latest_state",
        "domain_type": "Point",
        "object_kind": "point",
        "state_kind": "coordinate"
      }
    },
    "target": {
      "required": true,
      "domain_type": "Point",
      "runtime_type": "PointRef",
      "view": {
        "mode": "identity",
        "domain_type": "Point",
        "object_kind": "point",
        "state_kind": "coordinate"
      }
    }
  },
  "outputs": {

  },
  "is_pure": true,
  "preconditions": [

    "x_axis_point 与 reference_x_axis_point 在以 origin 为原点的水平轴上",
    "y_axis_point 在以 origin 为原点的竖直轴上"
  ],
  "do_not_use_when": [
    "只有原始角和条件、尚未得到 AngleEquality 时，不能直接使用本能力。",
    "等角两边不能形成两个非退化直角三角形，或目标不是竖直轴截点。",
    "最终答案是抛物线上的曲线点时，不要把本能力的辅助轴截点直接绑定为该答案。",
    "不要手工交换目标水平轴点、参考水平轴点、竖直轴点和原点；这些机械角色由 AngleEquality 决定。"
  ],
  "postconditions": [
    "输出点在 y 轴上，且满足 OF/OB=AO/CO"
  ],

绑定后的教学材料
[
  {
    "nav_title": "等角求截点",
    "title": "由等角关系求辅助点坐标",
    "goal": "由等锐角得到正切比相等，求目标直线在坐标轴上的截点。",
    "derive": [
      [
        "∵",
        "B、E、F 共线，所以 ∠OBF＝∠OBE＝∠ACO"
      ],
      [
        "∵",
        "Rt△BOF 与 Rt△AOC 均为直角三角形"
      ],
      [
        "∴",
        "tan∠OBF＝OF/OB，tan∠ACO＝AO/CO"
      ],
      [
        "∴",
        "OF/OB＝AO/CO"
      ],
      [
        "计算",
        "OB＝3，AO＝1，CO＝3，所以 OF＝1"
      ],
      [
        "∵",
        "F 在 y 轴负半轴上"
      ],
      [
        "∴",
        "F(0,－1)"
      ]
    ],
    "box": [
      "F(0,－1)"
    ],
    "unit_key": "axis_intercept_from_equal_acute_angles/solve_intercept"
  }
]

Public contract
{
  "QuadraticPathMinimumSolver": {
    "capability_id": "coupled_segment_endpoint_replacement_path_minimum",
    "title": "耦合线段端点替换路径最值",
    "use_when": "当两动点分别位于两条相接线段，且题面比例/等长关系能够把两动点之间的距离替换为已有固定端点到保留动点的距离时，原子完成端点替换、单动点轨迹、折线拉直、最小值和取等点。Planner 只选择路径目标与负责耦合的线段关系；成员关系、端点和保留动点由代码解析。若其中的固定端点由中点等题面构造定义，先用对应普通 Function 物化该点坐标；这只是准备输入，不是展开 Macro。",
    "args": [
      {
        "name": "path_minimum_target",
        "domain_type": "Fact",
        "required": true,
        "cardinality": "one",
        "fact_types": [
          "path_minimum_target"
        ]
      },
      {
        "name": "segment_binding_relation",
        "domain_type": "Fact",
        "required": true,
        "cardinality": "one",
        "fact_types": [
          "segment_relation",
          "segment_length_relation"
        ]
      }
    ],
    "returns": [
      {
        "name": "minimum_expression",
        "type": "MinimumExpression",
        "binding": "call_result_or_answer_or_existing_object",
        "desc": "仍依赖题面参数时为 open_expression；参数确定后为 closed_value。",
        "return_expectation_policy": "selectable",
        "possible_forms": [
          "open_expression",
          "closed_value"
        ]
      },
      {
        "name": "attainment_point",
        "type": "Point",
        "binding": "exact_call_result_or_answer",
        "reference_mode": "exact_result",
        "desc": "端点替换后保留动点的取等状态；身份由代码从路径和线段关系中确定，后续通过 StepResultRef 消费。 坐标仍含未确定符号时为 open_state；不存在自由符号时为 closed_state。重复写入同一对象时，代码会验证它是否为状态收敛。",
        "return_expectation_policy": "selectable",
        "possible_forms": [
          "open_state",
          "closed_state"
        ]
      }
    ],
    "do_not_use_when": [
      "路径本身已经只有一个动点，不需要耦合端点替换。",
      "比例关系要求创建新的辅助点、射线、正方形变换或非1权重构造。",
      "两动点的成员关系与耦合线段不能形成唯一连通结构。",
      "保留动点的轨迹不是直线。"
    ]
  }
}

[
  {
    "nav_title": "端点替换",
    "title": "利用线段关系替换耦合端点",
    "goal": "由运行时验证的几何关系作垂足，证明垂直平分线，再把两动点路径等价化为单动点路径。",
    "derive": [
      [
        "作",
        "GH⊥DN于H，GK⊥DM于K"
      ],
      [
        "∵",
        "△DMN是等腰直角三角形，G在线段MN上"
      ],
      [
        "∴",
        "△GNH是等腰直角三角形"
      ],
      [
        "∴",
        "GH＝HN＝NG/√2"
      ],
      [
        "∵",
        "四边形DKGH是矩形"
      ],
      [
        "∴",
        "DK＝GH，GK＝DH"
      ],
      [
        "∵",
        "DE＝√2·NG＝2GH"
      ],
      [
        "∴",
        "EK＝DE－DK＝GH＝DK"
      ],
      [
        "∵",
        "GK⊥DM，D、E、K在直线DM上"
      ],
      [
        "∴",
        "GK垂直平分DE"
      ],
      [
        "∴",
        "△DGE是等腰三角形，EG＝DG"
      ],
      [
        "∴",
        "EG＋FG＝DG＋FG"
      ]
    ],
    "box": [
      "EG+FG＝DG+FG"
    ],
    "unit_key": "coupled_segment_endpoint_replacement_path_minimum/endpoint_replacement"
  },
  {
    "nav_title": "轨迹与最短路径",
    "title": "确定G的轨迹并拉直折线",
    "goal": "在保留动点的合法轨迹上拉直折线，求最小值和取等位置。",
    "derive": [
      [
        "∵",
        "G 的轨迹为 线段MN"
      ],
      [
        "作",
        "关于G的轨迹作D的对称点D′(m+1,2-m)"
      ],
      [
        "∴",
        "DG+FG＝D′G+FG≥D′F"
      ],
      [
        "∴",
        "最小值为 √(5m²-10m+10)/2"
      ],
      [
        "∴",
        "在 G(m/3+4/3,1-2m/3) 处取得"
      ]
    ],
    "box": [
      "最小值为 √(5m²-10m+10)/2",
      "取等点为 G(m/3+4/3,1-2m/3)"
    ],
    "unit_key": "coupled_segment_endpoint_replacement_path_minimum/reflection_minimum"
  }
]

          "GK垂直平分DE"
        ],
        [
          "∴",
          "△DGE是等腰三角形，EG＝DG"
        ],
        [
          "∴",
          "EG＋FG＝DG＋FG"
        ]
      ],
      "box": [
        "EG+FG＝DG+FG"
      ]
    },
    {
      "lesson_step_id": "teach:ii_path_minimum:coupled_segment_endpoint_replacement_path_minimum/reflection_minimum",

      ],
      "title": "确定G的轨迹并拉直折线",
      "nav_title": "轨迹与最短路径",
      "goal": "在保留动点的合法轨迹上拉直折线，求最小值和取等位置。",
      "derive": [
        [
          "∵",
          "G 的轨迹为 线段MN"
        ],
        [
          "作",
          "关于G的轨迹作D的对称点D′(m+1,2-m)"
        ],
        [
          "∴",
          "DG+FG＝D′G+FG≥D′F"
        ],
        [
          "∴",
          "最小值为 √(5m²-10m+10)/2"
        ],
        [
          "∴",
          "在 G(m/3+4/3,1-2m/3) 处取得"
        ]
      ],
      "box": [
        "最小值为 √(5m²-10m+10)/2",
        "取等点为 G(m/3+4/3,1-2m/3)"
      ]
    }

Public contract
{
  "QuadraticWeightedPathMinimumSolver": {
    "capability_id": "curve_candidate_parameter_solve",
    "title": "曲线候选点筛选并反求参数",
    "use_when": "前序几何构造已经产生一组有坐标的候选点后，用当前问含参抛物线和参数约束筛出唯一候选点，再把该含参点代入抛物线反求参数并代回抛物线。candidates 必须引用前序调用实际产出的候选点集合，不能把尚未求出坐标的目标点包成单元素伪候选列表。若曲线条件本身不能唯一排除分支时，runtime 会按残余符号自动绑定唯一可见的 symbol_constraint；只有存在多个非等价候选时才需要显式消歧。",
    "args": [
      {
        "name": "candidates",
        "domain_type": "Point",
        "required": true,
        "cardinality": "many",
        "role": "前序几何构造调用实际产出的候选点列表；每个候选都必须已有坐标状态。不能填写尚未求出坐标的目标点，也不能填写只含目标对象的伪候选列表。"
      },
      {
        "name": "parabola",
        "domain_type": "QuadraticFunction",
        "required": true,
        "cardinality": "one",
        "role": "用于检验候选点并反求参数的当前含参抛物线状态。"
      },
      {
        "name": "target_point",
        "domain_type": "Point",
        "required": true,
        "cardinality": "one",
        "role": "候选筛选后要写入坐标的题面目标点身份；它不是 candidates 的替代输入。"
      },
      {
        "name": "point_on_curve",
        "domain_type": "Fact",
        "required": false,
        "cardinality": "one",
        "fact_types": [
          "point_on_curve"
        ],
        "role": "目标点属于该抛物线的结构化条件。"
      },
      {
        "name": "symbol_constraint",
        "domain_type": "Fact",
        "required": false,
        "cardinality": "one",
        "fact_types": [
          "symbol_constraint"
        ],
        "role": "用于排除候选分支的参数范围或符号约束。runtime 会按曲线残余符号自动绑定唯一可见约束；仅在多个非等价约束都可用时填写此参数进行消歧。"
      }
    ],
    "returns": [
      {
        "name": "selected_curve_point",
        "type": "Point",
        "binding": "call_result_or_answer_or_existing_object",
        "desc": "坐标仍含未确定符号时为 open_state；不存在自由符号时为 closed_state。重复写入同一对象时，代码会验证它是否为状态收敛。",
        "return_expectation_policy": "selectable",
        "possible_forms": [
          "open_state",
          "closed_state"
        ]
      },
      {
        "name": "parameter_value",
        "type": "ParameterValue",
        "binding": "call_result_or_answer_or_existing_object",
        "required": false,
        "cardinality": "optional"
      },
      {
        "name": "solved_parabola",
        "type": "Parabola",
        "binding": "same_object_as:parabola",
        "required": false,
        "cardinality": "optional",
        "desc": "抛物线状态仍含未确定系数或参数时为 open_state；不存在自由符号时为 closed_state。代码以 runtime 表达式的自由符号为准。",
        "return_expectation_policy": "selectable",
        "possible_forms": [
          "open_state",
          "closed_state"
        ]
      }
    ],
    "do_not_use_when": [
      "目标点已经在题面结构化声明横坐标，只需代入抛物线求纵坐标。",
      "当前没有前序几何构造产生的 materialized PointList 候选状态。",
      "试图把尚未求坐标的 target_point 本身或只含该对象的列表作为 candidates。",
      "多个候选都可能满足曲线方程，但没有提供用于选择分支的参数范围或符号约束；不要假定默认旋转方向。"
    ]
  }
}

[
  {
    "nav_title": "筛选D并求参",
    "title": "代入抛物线筛选D并求参数",
    "goal": "把前一步得到的两个D位置分别代入抛物线，结合参数范围判断取舍并求出参数。",
    "derive": [
      [
        "∵",
        "D 在抛物线 y＝2x²－bx－b－2 上"
      ],
      [
        "∵",
        "将 D₁(－b－3,－1) 代入，得b(3b＋14)＝－17"
      ],
      [
        "∴",
        "结合b＞0，排除D₁"
      ],
      [
        "∵",
        "将 D₂(b＋1,1) 代入，得b(b＋2)＝1"
      ],
      [
        "∴",
        "结合b＞0，保留D₂"
      ],
      [
        "∴",
        "D＝D₂，即D(b＋1,1)"
      ],
      [
        "∵",
        "b(b＋2)＝1，b＞0"
      ],
      [
        "∴",
        "b＝√2－1"
      ]
    ],
    "box": [
      "b＝√2－1"
    ],
    "unit_key": "curve_candidate_parameter_solve/filter_candidates"
  },
  {
    "nav_title": "回代求D",
    "title": "回代参数确定D的坐标",
    "goal": "把上一步求出的参数同时代回点与抛物线，确认已知点和最终点都在同一条确定的曲线上。",
    "derive": [
      [
        "∵",
        "b＝√2－1，D₂(b＋1,1)"
      ],
      [
        "∴",
        "D(√2,1)"
      ]
    ],
    "box": [
      "D(√2,1)"
    ],
    "unit_key": "curve_candidate_parameter_solve/solve_parameter_and_curve"
  }
]

Public contract
{
  "QuadraticEqualLengthRayPathMinimumSolver": {
    "capability_id": "equal_length_ray_path_reduction",
    "title": "等长射线路径降维为单距离最值",
    "use_when": "仅用于一个动点在线段上、另一个动点在射线上，并且题设给出二者相对同一端点的等长关系。该能力在内部完成辅助点构造，把两动点距离和直接化为一个固定点到辅助点的单距离最小值表达式；它返回 MinimumExpression，而不是供后续普通折线拉直的内部路径中间值。结果仍含参数时为开放表达式，不含自由参数时为闭合值。",
    "args": [
      {
        "name": "path_minimum_target",
        "domain_type": "Fact",
        "required": true,
        "cardinality": "one",
        "fact_types": [
          "path_minimum_target"
        ]
      },
      {
        "name": "equal_length_condition",
        "domain_type": "Fact",
        "required": true,
        "cardinality": "one",
        "fact_types": [
          "equal_length_condition"
        ]
      },
      {
        "name": "point_on_segment",
        "domain_type": "Fact",
        "required": true,
        "cardinality": "one",
        "fact_types": [
          "point_on_segment"
        ]
      },
      {
        "name": "point_on_ray",
        "domain_type": "Fact",
        "required": true,
        "cardinality": "one",
        "fact_types": [
          "point_on_ray"
        ]
      }
    ],
    "returns": [
      {
        "name": "minimum_expression",
        "type": "MinimumExpression",
        "binding": "call_result_or_answer_or_existing_object",
        "desc": "端点仍含未确定参数时为 open_expression；不存在自由参数时为 closed_value，可直接作为数值答案。",
        "return_expectation_policy": "selectable",
        "possible_forms": [
          "open_expression",
          "closed_value"
        ]
      }
    ],
    "do_not_use_when": [
      "缺少“一个点在线段、一个点在射线、相对同一端点等长”中的任一结构化条件。",
      "原路径只是普通两段等长/比例替换、三段正方形路径或带权距离；这些结构应使用各自的路径降维能力。"
    ]
  }
}

绑定后的教学材料
[
  {
    "nav_title": "两动点转化",
    "title": "构造等长辅助点，把两动点路径化为单动点路径",
    "goal": "利用等长条件构造辅助点，证明原路径可等价替换。",
    "derive": [
      [
        "作",
        "在射线CD上构造G，使CG＝CB"
      ],
      [
        "∵",
        "CN＝CM；CB＝CG；M在线段CB上，N、G在射线CD上，故∠BCN＝∠GCM"
      ],
      [
        "∴",
        "△BCN≌△GCM（边角边），故BN＝MG"
      ],
      [
        "∴",
        "OM＋BN＝OM＋MG"
      ]
    ],
    "box": [
      "OM＋BN＝OM＋MG"
    ],
    "unit_key": "equal_length_ray_path_reduction/path_reduction"
  },
  {
    "nav_title": "单动点路径最值",
    "title": "在单动点路径中求最小值",
    "goal": "在等价路径中利用两点之间线段最短得到最小值。",
    "derive": [
      [
        "∵",
        "OM＋BN＝OM＋MG"
      ],
      [
        "∴",
        "OM＋MG≥OG"
      ],
      [
        "计算",
        "OG＝√[(3√(a²＋1)/|a|)²＋(－3)²]＝3√(2a²＋1)/|a|"
      ],
      [
        "∴",
        "路径最小值为 3√(2a²＋1)/|a|"
      ]
    ],
    "box": [
      "路径最小值为 3√(2a²＋1)/|a|"
    ],
    "unit_key": "equal_length_ray_path_reduction/minimum_by_segment"
  }
]

{
  "QuadraticEqualLengthRayPathMinimumSolver": {
    "capability_id": "equal_length_ray_point",
    "title": "射线上等长构造点",
    "use_when": "当已知射线端点、射线方向点和参考线段另一端，需要在该射线上构造等长点时使用。输出满足 anchor-target = anchor-reference；若它只是后续计算的辅助点，无需绑定题面对象，直接引用本调用结果。",
    "args": [],
    "returns": [
      {
        "name": "point",
        "type": "Point",
        "binding": "call_result_or_answer_or_existing_object",
        "desc": "射线上的等长构造点。作为中间辅助点时可不绑定题面对象，后续调用直接引用本 call 的 point 结果；作为题面对象或答案时仍应显式绑定。 坐标仍含未确定符号时为 open_state；不存在自由符号时为 closed_state。重复写入同一对象时，代码会验证它是否为状态收敛。",
        "return_expectation_policy": "selectable",
        "possible_forms": [
          "open_state",
          "closed_state"
        ]
      }
    ],
    "do_not_use_when": [
      "只有线段长度、但没有由两个不同点确定的射线方向。",
      "目标是求曲线交点、坐标轴截点或路径最小值，而不是先构造射线上等长点。"
    ]
  }
}

{
  "method_id": "equal_length_ray_point",
  "title": "射线上等长构造点",
  "description": "在一条射线上构造点，使它到端点的距离等于另一条已知线段。",
  "summary": "当已知射线端点、射线方向点和参考线段另一端，需要在该射线上构造等长点时使用。输出满足 anchor-target = anchor-reference；若它只是后续计算的辅助点，无需绑定题面对象，直接引用本调用结果。",
  "solves": [
    "derive_equal_length_point_on_ray"
  ],
  "inputs": {

    "use_when": "对已经得到的 Expression、MinimumExpression 或 Parabola 状态代入一个同身份参数值，并输出同类型状态。输入类型决定唯一 return：Expression 输出 evaluated_expression，MinimumExpression 输出 evaluated_minimum_expression，Parabola 输出 evaluated_parabola。代入一个参数不保证其他自由参数也已闭合；最终结果形态由剩余自由符号决定。若输入已经完全闭合，重复求值是保持同类型和同值的安全 no-op。",
    "args": [
      {
        "name": "expression",
        "domain_type": "Expression",
        "required": true,
        "cardinality": "one",
        "role": "需要代入一个已知参数值的当前 Expression、MinimumExpression 或 Parabola 状态。题面 Function 模板不是已经得到的 Parabola 状态；输入类型会确定唯一的同类型 return。"
      },
      {
        "name": "parameter",
        "domain_type": "Symbol",
        "required": false,
        "cardinality": "one"
      },
      {
        "name": "parameter_value",
        "domain_type": "Symbol",
        "required": true,
        "cardinality": "one"
      }
    ],
    "returns": [
      {
        "name": "evaluated_expression",
        "type": "Expression",
        "binding": "call_result_or_answer_or_existing_object",
        "required": false,
        "desc": "仅当输入是 Expression 状态时产生；不能作为 Parabola 传给曲线顶点、交点或对称轴能力。 代入后仍含未确定参数时为 open_expression；不存在自由参数时为 closed_value。",
        "return_expectation_policy": "selectable",
        "possible_forms": [
          "open_expression",
          "closed_value"
        ]
      },
      {
        "name": "evaluated_minimum_expression",
        "type": "MinimumExpression",
        "binding": "call_result_or_answer_or_existing_object",
        "required": false,
        "desc": "仅当输入是 MinimumExpression 状态时产生。 代入后仍含未确定参数时为 open_expression；不存在自由参数时为 closed_value，可直接作为数值答案。",
        "return_expectation_policy": "selectable",
        "possible_forms": [
          "open_expression",
          "closed_value"
        ]
      },
      {
        "name": "evaluated_parabola",
        "type": "Parabola",
        "binding": "same_object_as:expression",
        "required": false,
        "desc": "仅当输入已经是 Parabola 状态时产生，表示代入参数后的同一抛物线状态；普通 Expression 输入不会产生该 return。 抛物线状态仍含未确定系数或参数时为 open_state；不存在自由符号时为 closed_state。代码以 runtime 表达式的自由符号为准。",
        "return_expectation_policy": "selectable",
        "possible_forms": [
          "open_state",
          "closed_state"
        ]
      }
    ],
    "do_not_use_when": [
      "只有 ProblemIR 中的 Function 模板、尚未得到同一函数对象的 Parabola 状态；建立抛物线应使用 quadratic_from_constraints。",
      "需要依次代入多个已知二次函数系数；应把这些系数值一次放入 quadratic_from_constraints.known_coefficients。",
      "不要假定 evaluated_expression、evaluated_minimum_expression 和 evaluated_parabola 会同时产生；实际 return 只由输入状态类型决定。",
      "表达式仍含自由符号但不含待代入 Symbol，或 ParameterValue 属于另一个 Symbol；例如表达式只含参数 u 时，不能用参数 v 的值关闭该表达式。",
      "试图通过代入无关参数改变或关闭函数状态；应先选择实际出现在该状态自由符号集合中的参数。",
      "仅为了重复关闭一个已经闭合的状态而新增本步骤；运行时会安全地视为 no-op，但 Planner 通常应直接复用该状态。"
    ]
  },

    "use_when": "Given 含参点坐标、一个参数符号和同身份参数值, derive 代入该参数后的同一 Point 状态；其他尚未求值的自由符号可以保留。",
    "args": [

    "evaluate_point_at_parameter"

{
  "QuadraticEqualLengthRayPathMinimumSolver": {
    "capability_id": "line_parabola_second_intersection_point",
    "title": "求直线与抛物线的另一交点",
    "use_when": "输入: 抛物线、确定直线的两点、已知交点和目标 Point identity；输出: 直线与抛物线的另一个交点。line_p1/line_p2 顺序可交换，且任一端点都可来自匿名步骤结果。可用 target.x_range 选择符合题设范围的点。",
    "args": [
      {
        "name": "parabola",
        "domain_type": "QuadraticFunction",
        "required": true,
        "cardinality": "one",
        "role": "读取当前函数对象已计算出的抛物线状态。允许 closed_state，或只依赖一个独立自由参数的 open_state；题面 Function 模板仅在代码能由可见系数值确定性物化到该边界时可直接引用。"
      },
      {
        "name": "line_p1",
        "domain_type": "Point",
        "required": true,
        "cardinality": "one",
        "role": "确定目标直线的第一个点；必须与 line_p2 的横坐标不同。若该点也是抛物线已知交点，通常同时把它传给 known_point。"
      },
      {
        "name": "line_p2",
        "domain_type": "Point",
        "required": true,
        "cardinality": "one",
        "role": "确定目标直线的第二个点；必须与 line_p1 的横坐标不同，从而得到非竖直直线。"
      },
      {
        "name": "known_point",
        "domain_type": "Point",
        "required": true,
        "cardinality": "one",
        "role": "目标直线与抛物线共有、并需要从联立结果中排除的已知交点；通常直接复用 line_p1 或 line_p2，禁止传入不在目标直线上的点。"
      }
    ],
    "returns": [
      {
        "name": "point",
        "type": "Point",

        "return_expectation_policy": "selectable",
        "possible_forms": [
          "open_state",
          "closed_state"
        ],
        "provides": [
          "curve_intersection_point"
        ]
      }

    "do_not_use_when": [
      "line_p1 与 line_p2 横坐标相同或两点重合，无法确定本方法支持的非竖直直线。",
      "known_point 不同时位于目标直线和抛物线上；不要仅因它在抛物线上就把它作为排除点。"
    ],
    "input_requirements": [
      {
        "requirement": "输出由已知直线与抛物线的另一个交点推出，因此携带曲线成员证据。"
      },
      {
        "requirement": "line_p1、line_p2 必须引用彼此不同的语义状态。"
      },
      {
        "requirement": "line_p1、line_p2 表示无序的等价输入槽位；交换它们不改变数学结果。"
      }
    ]
  },

{
  "method_id": "parameter_from_expression_value",

      }

Public contract
{
  "QuadraticPathMinimumSolver": {
    "capability_id": "parameter_from_minimum_value",
    "title": "由最小值反求参数",
    "use_when": "输入: 最小值表达式与给定最小值条件；输出: 参数值。",
    "args": [
      {
        "name": "minimum_expression",
        "domain_type": "Expression",
        "required": true,
        "cardinality": "one"
      },
      {
        "name": "minimum_value",
        "domain_type": "Fact",
        "required": true,
        "cardinality": "one",
        "fact_types": [
          "minimum_value"
        ]
      },
      {
        "name": "parameter",
        "domain_type": "Symbol",
        "required": false,
        "cardinality": "one"
      }
    ],
    "returns": [
      {
        "name": "parameter_value",
        "type": "ParameterValue",
        "binding": "same_object_as:parameter"
      }
    ],
    "do_not_use_when": [
      "输入表达式不具有最小值语义，或题面给出的只是普通表达式取值条件。",
      "尚未得到可代入的最小值表达式。",
      "最小值表达式仍含两个或更多相互独立的未知 Symbol；应先化为单一未知量。",
      "当前目标只是更新函数或几何对象状态；该能力只反求最小值表达式中实际存在的单一目标参数，不代替状态更新。",
      "最小值方程有多个合法参数分支但没有提供足以唯一筛选的结构化 constraint；不会默认选择第一个解。"
    ]
  }
}
Method / Recipe Spec
{
  "method_id": "parameter_from_minimum_value",
  "title": "由最小值反求参数",
  "description": "由最小值表达式和目标值反求参数。",
  "summary": "输入: 最小值表达式与给定最小值条件；输出: 参数值。",
  "solves": [
    "derive_parameter_from_minimum_value"
  ],
  "inputs": {
    "minimum_expression": {
      "required": true,
      "domain_type": "Expression",
      "runtime_type": "MinimumExpression",
      "view": {
        "mode": "exact_result",
        "domain_type": "Expression"
      }
    },
    "condition": {
      "required": true,
      "domain_type": "Fact",
      "runtime_type": "Condition",
      "view": {
        "mode": "immutable_value",
        "domain_type": "Fact"
      }
    },
    "parameter": {
      "required": true,
      "domain_type": "Symbol",
      "runtime_type": "Symbol",
      "view": {
        "mode": "identity",
        "domain_type": "Symbol",
        "object_kind": "symbol",
        "state_kind": "value"
      }
    },
    "constraint": {
      "required": false,
      "domain_type": "Fact",
      "runtime_type": "Constraint",
      "view": {
        "mode": "immutable_value",
        "domain_type": "Fact"
      }
    }
  },
  "outputs": {
    "parameter_value": "ParameterValue"
  },
  "is_pure": true,
  "preconditions": [
    "parameter 必须实际参与 minimum_expression=condition.value 方程",
    "若方程有多个分支，constraint 必须唯一筛选一个合法分支"
  ],
  "do_not_use_when": [
    "输入表达式不具有最小值语义，或题面给出的只是普通表达式取值条件。",
    "尚未得到可代入的最小值表达式。",
    "最小值表达式仍含两个或更多相互独立的未知 Symbol；应先化为单一未知量。",
    "当前目标只是更新函数或几何对象状态；该能力只反求最小值表达式中实际存在的单一目标参数，不代替状态更新。",
    "最小值方程有多个合法参数分支但没有提供足以唯一筛选的结构化 constraint；不会默认选择第一个解。"
  ],
  "postconditions": [
    "输出参数值满足最小值方程与声明的参数范围"
  ],
  "teaching_unit": {
    "unit_key": "parameter_from_minimum_value/solve_parameter",
    "title_template": "由最小值反求参数",
    "nav_title_template": "反求参数",
    "goal_template": "令已得到的最小值表达式等于题设值，解参数并筛选合法分支。",
    "derive_templates": [
      [
        "∵",
        "{minimum_expression}＝{condition}"
      ],
      [
        "计算",
        "解关于 {parameter} 的方程并按定义域筛选"
      ],
      [
        "∴",
        "{parameter}＝{parameter_value}"
      ]
    ],
    "box_templates": [
      "{parameter}＝{parameter_value}"
    ],
    "role_schema": {
      "minimum_expression": "前序步骤得到的最小值表达式。",
      "condition": "题设给出的最小值条件。",
      "parameter": "待求参数。",
      "parameter_value": "合法参数值。"
    },
    "role_binder_id": "parameter_from_minimum_value"
  },
  "visual": {

{
  "QuadraticPathMinimumSolver": {
    "capability_id": "parameter_from_segment_length",
    "title": "由线段长度求参数",
    "use_when": "输入: 线段端点和长度/线段比例条件；输出: 满足条件的参数值。支持 MN²=10 与 AD=2BC 这类原始线段关系。",
    "args": [
      {
        "name": "p1",
        "domain_type": "Point",
        "required": true,
        "cardinality": "one"
      },
      {
        "name": "p2",
        "domain_type": "Point",
        "required": true,
        "cardinality": "one"
      },
      {
        "name": "reference_p1",
        "domain_type": "Point",
        "required": false,
        "cardinality": "one"
      },
      {
        "name": "reference_p2",
        "domain_type": "Point",
        "required": false,
        "cardinality": "one"
      },
      {
        "name": "parameter",
        "domain_type": "Symbol",
        "required": false,
        "cardinality": "one"
      },
      {
        "name": "length_squared",
        "domain_type": "Fact",
        "required": true,
        "cardinality": "one",
        "fact_types": [
          "length_squared",
          "segment_length_relation"
        ]
      }
    ],
    "returns": [
      {
        "name": "parameter_value",
        "type": "ParameterValue",
        "binding": "same_object_as:parameter"
      }
    ],
    "do_not_use_when": [
      "parameter 没有实际出现在由端点和长度条件建立的方程中。",
      "线段比例条件缺少对应 reference_p1/reference_p2；不能按点名或条件文本猜测参照端点。",
      "长度方程有多个合法参数分支但没有提供足以唯一筛选的结构化 constraint；不会默认选择第一个解。"
    ],
    "input_requirements": [
      {
        "requirement": "p1、p2 必须是长度条件所声明线段的两个端点；端点顺序可以交换。"
      },
      {
        "requirement": "比例长度条件的 reference_p1、reference_p2 必须是参照线段的两个端点；端点顺序可以交换。"
      },
      {
        "requirement": "p1、p2 表示无序的等价输入槽位；交换它们不改变数学结果。"
      },
      {
        "requirement": "reference_p1、reference_p2 表示无序的等价输入槽位；交换它们不改变数学结果。"
      }
    ]
  },

Public contract
{
  "QuadraticSquareReflectionPathMinimumSolver": {
    "capability_id": "point_candidates_from_curve_point_condition",
    "title": "由曲线点条件求目标点候选",
    "use_when": "Given 待返回的目标点 P(t)、仅用于施加曲线条件的点 Q(t) 和已解抛物线, derive 使 Q(t) 在曲线上的 P 候选列表。返回值是一个整体的 PointList；列表中的每个候选保持 target_point=P 的对象身份，curve_point=Q 只提供约束。PointList 不能绑定为单个 Point。适用于几何构造先得到两个同参数点，再用 Q 落曲线来反求 P 的场景。",
    "args": [
      {
        "name": "target_point",
        "domain_type": "Point",
        "required": true,
        "cardinality": "one"
      },
      {
        "name": "curve_point",
        "domain_type": "Point",
        "required": true,
        "cardinality": "one"
      },
      {
        "name": "parabola",
        "domain_type": "QuadraticFunction",
        "required": true,
        "cardinality": "one",
        "role": "读取当前函数对象已计算出的抛物线状态。允许 closed_state，或只依赖一个独立自由参数的 open_state；题面 Function 模板仅在代码能由可见系数值确定性物化到该边界时可直接引用。"
      },
      {
        "name": "parameter",
        "domain_type": "Symbol",
        "required": true,
        "cardinality": "one"
      }
    ],
    "returns": [
      {
        "name": "candidates",
        "type": "PointList",
        "binding": "aggregate_elements_same_object_as:target_point",
        "value_cardinality": "aggregate",
        "desc": "返回值是一个整体的 PointList 聚合值，不是单个对象。列表元素保持 target_point 的对象身份；若绑定 required answer，必须使用 answer 类型的 binding 且 value_type=PointList；不得绑定为单个对象。"
      }
    ]
  }
}
Method / Recipe Spec
{
  "method_id": "point_candidates_from_curve_point_condition",
  "title": "由曲线点条件求目标点候选",
  "description": "把同参数曲线点代入二次函数，反求另一个目标点的候选。",
  "summary": "Given 待返回的目标点 P(t)、仅用于施加曲线条件的点 Q(t) 和已解抛物线, derive 使 Q(t) 在曲线上的 P 候选列表。返回值是一个整体的 PointList；列表中的每个候选保持 target_point=P 的对象身份，curve_point=Q 只提供约束。PointList 不能绑定为单个 Point。适用于几何构造先得到两个同参数点，再用 Q 落曲线来反求 P 的场景。",
  "solves": [
    "derive_point_candidates_from_curve_point_condition"
  ],
  "inputs": {
    "target_point": {
      "required": true,
      "symbolic_basis_role": "align_to_anchor",
      "description": "需要返回候选坐标的目标 Point；candidates 列表中的每个候选保持这个对象身份，但 candidates 本身仍是 PointList。",
      "domain_type": "Point",
      "runtime_type": "Point",
      "view": {
        "mode": "latest_state",
        "domain_type": "Point",
        "object_kind": "point",
        "state_kind": "coordinate"
      }
    },
    "curve_point": {
      "required": true,
      "symbolic_basis_role": "align_to_anchor",
      "description": "代入 parabola 建立参数方程的 Point；只提供约束，不作为返回对象。",
      "domain_type": "Point",
      "runtime_type": "Point",
      "view": {
        "mode": "latest_state",
        "domain_type": "Point",
        "object_kind": "point",
        "state_kind": "coordinate"
      }
    },
    "parabola": {

Public contract
{
  "QuadraticPathMinimumSolver": {

    "title": "由系数关系求对称轴交点",
    "use_when": "输入: 二次函数系数关系与目标点定义；输出: 对称轴与 x 轴交点。",
    "args": [
      {
        "name": "coefficient_relation",
        "domain_type": "Fact",
        "required": true,
        "cardinality": "one"
      }
    ],
    "returns": [
      {
        "name": "axis_point",
        "type": "Point",
        "binding": "call_result_or_answer_or_existing_object",
        "desc": "坐标仍含未确定符号时为 open_state；不存在自由符号时为 closed_state。重复写入同一对象时，代码会验证它是否为状态收敛。",
        "return_expectation_policy": "selectable",
        "possible_forms": [
          "open_state",
          "closed_state"
        ]
      }
    ]
  }
}
Method / Recipe Spec
{
  "method_id": "quadratic_axis_from_relation",
  "title": "由系数关系求对称轴交点",
  "description": "由二次函数系数关系求对称轴与 x 轴交点。",
  "summary": "输入: 二次函数系数关系与目标点定义；输出: 对称轴与 x 轴交点。",
  "solves": [
    "derive_axis_point"
  ],
  "inputs": {
    "coefficient_relation": {
      "required": true,
      "domain_type": "Fact",
      "runtime_type": "Equation",
      "view": {
        "mode": "immutable_value",
        "domain_type": "Fact"
      }
    },
    "a": {
      "required": true,
      "domain_type": "Symbol",
      "runtime_type": "Symbol",
      "view": {
        "mode": "identity",
        "domain_type": "Symbol",
        "object_kind": "symbol",
        "state_kind": "value"
      }
    },
    "b": {
      "required": true,
      "domain_type": "Symbol",
      "runtime_type": "Symbol",
      "view": {
        "mode": "identity",
        "domain_type": "Symbol",
        "object_kind": "symbol",
        "state_kind": "value"
      }
    },
    "target": {
      "required": true,
      "domain_type": "Point",
      "runtime_type": "PointRef",
      "view": {
        "mode": "identity",
        "domain_type": "Point",
        "object_kind": "point",
        "state_kind": "coordinate"
      }
    }
  },
  "outputs": {
    "axis_point": "Point"
  },
  "is_pure": true,
  "preconditions": [
    "coefficient_relation 必须包含二次项系数 a 和一次项系数 b",
    "coefficient_relation 解出 b 后，-b/(2a) 不能再依赖 a 或 b；也就是关系必须能确定 b/a 的比值"
  ],
  "teaching_unit": {
    "unit_key": "quadratic_axis_from_relation/derive_axis",

      ],
      [
        "∴",

  },
  "visual": {

Public contract
{
  "QuadraticSquareReflectionPathMinimumSolver": {
    "capability_id": "quadratic_axis_parameterized_point",
    "title": "构造对称轴参数化点",
    "use_when": "Given 已解抛物线和目标 Point identity, derive 该点在抛物线对称轴上的参数化坐标。适用于后续再由几何或曲线条件求参数的步骤。输出参数是绑定到该 Point 的新坐标参数，默认不等于抛物线系数或其他可见参数。",
    "args": [
      {
        "name": "parabola",
        "domain_type": "QuadraticFunction",
        "required": true,
        "cardinality": "one",
        "role": "读取当前函数对象已计算出的抛物线状态。允许 closed_state，或只依赖一个独立自由参数的 open_state；题面 Function 模板仅在代码能由可见系数值确定性物化到该边界时可直接引用。"
      }
    ],
    "returns": [
      {
        "name": "point",
        "type": "Point",
        "binding": "call_result_or_answer_or_existing_object",
        "required": false,
        "desc": "坐标仍含该 Point 专属参数时为 open_state；只有该参数已由同身份 ParameterValue 消去后才是 closed_state。",
        "return_expectation_policy": "selectable",
        "possible_forms": [
          "open_state",
          "closed_state"
        ],
        "target_selection": {
          "fact_kind": "axis_membership",
          "target_field": "point",
          "description": "若可见 axis_membership 事实唯一确定当前抛物线对称轴上的 Point，则代码可绑定该已有对象；存在多个候选时必须显式 output_targets。",
          "related_arg": "parabola",
          "related_field": "curve",
          "required_fields": {
            "axis": "symmetry"
          },
          "policy": "unique_visible_fact_target"
        }
      },
      {
        "name": "parameter",
        "type": "Symbol",
        "binding": "internal_only"
      }
    ],
    "do_not_use_when": [
      "只有某个抛物线系数或其他 Symbol 的值，却没有条件证明它就是目标点的坐标参数；不同 Symbol identity 的参数值不能互相代入。"
    ]
  }
}
Method / Recipe Spec
{
  "method_id": "quadratic_axis_parameterized_point",
  "title": "构造对称轴参数化点",
  "description": "由抛物线对称轴构造目标点的参数化坐标。",
  "summary": "Given 已解抛物线和目标 PointRef, derive 该点在抛物线对称轴上的参数化坐标。适用于后续再由几何或曲线条件求参数的步骤。输出参数是绑定到该 Point 的新坐标参数，默认不等于抛物线系数或其他可见参数。",
  "solves": [
    "parameterize_point_on_quadratic_axis"
  ],
  "inputs": {
    "parabola": {
      "required": true,

Public contract
{
  "QuadraticEqualLengthRayPathMinimumSolver": {
    "capability_id": "quadratic_from_constraints",
    "title": "由二次函数约束求抛物线",
    "use_when": "根据当前scope中由编译器注入的唯一题面二次函数身份与可见状态，联立本步骤新增的已知系数、系数关系、曲线点、等式或参数值，输出最简系数与抛物线。Plan只填写catalog公开的约束参数；quadratic、parabola、x和all_coefficients均由编译器确定，不得自行放入args。指定target_parameter时还可输出该系数关于free_parameters的开放或闭合状态。使用原则：多个已知系数应一次放入 known_coefficients；单个运行参数代入才使用parameter_value；free_parameters必须给出应用本步骤当前scope约束后的一组完整独立参数基底：开放状态必填非空，闭合状态可填[]或省略。",
    "args": [
      {
        "name": "known_coefficients",
        "domain_type": "Fact",
        "required": false,
        "cardinality": "many",
        "fact_types": [
          "symbol_value"
        ],
        "role": "零个或多个已经求得的二次函数系数值。多个系数统一放在这里，不要再重复写入 parameter_value。"
      },
      {
        "name": "coefficient_relation",
        "domain_type": "Fact",
        "required": false,
        "cardinality": "one",
        "role": "题面给出的二次函数系数等式关系。"
      },
      {
        "name": "extra_equation",
        "domain_type": "Fact",
        "required": false,
        "cardinality": "one",
        "role": "用于求系数的额外等式。参数范围、不等式和定义域条件不能填入这里。"
      },
      {
        "name": "curve_point",
        "domain_type": "Point",
        "required": false,
        "cardinality": "one",
        "role": "单个已知坐标的曲线点；多个曲线点请改用 curve_points，不要在两个参数中重复同一点。"
      },
      {
        "name": "curve_points",
        "domain_type": "Point",
        "required": false,
        "cardinality": "many",
        "role": "零个或多个已知坐标的曲线点；每个点都会作为独立曲线约束。"
      },
      {
        "name": "free_parameters",
        "domain_type": "Symbol",
        "required": false,
        "cardinality": "many",
        "role": "应用当前scope约束后仍未确定的一组完整独立参数基底。开放状态必须填写非空基底；闭合状态可填写[]或省略。可使用runtime可证明等价的任一基底，不得按下游Goal目标人为收窄。"
      },
      {
        "name": "parameter_value",
        "domain_type": "Symbol",
        "required": false,
        "cardinality": "one",
        "role": "单个需要代入当前抛物线状态的已求参数值。它不是多个已知系数的容器；多个系数请使用 known_coefficients。"
      },
      {
        "name": "target_parameter",
        "domain_type": "Symbol",
        "required": false,
        "cardinality": "one",
        "role": "本轮希望明确求出的二次函数系数。"
      }
    ],
    "returns": [
      {
        "name": "coefficients",
        "type": "Coefficients",
        "binding": "call_result_or_answer_or_existing_object",
        "value_cardinality": "aggregate",
        "desc": "返回值是一个整体的 Coefficients 聚合值，不是单个对象。若绑定 required answer，必须使用 answer 类型的 binding 且 value_type=Coefficients；不得绑定为单个对象。"
      },
      {
        "name": "parabola",
        "type": "Parabola",
        "binding": "same_compiler_selected_object",
        "desc": "抛物线状态仍含未确定系数或参数时为 open_state；不存在自由符号时为 closed_state。代码以 runtime 表达式的自由符号为准。 对象身份由编译器从当前scope的题面权威中选择；不要为此添加catalog未声明的输入参数。",
        "return_expectation_policy": "selectable",
        "possible_forms": [
          "open_state",
          "closed_state"
        ]
      },
      {
        "name": "parameter_value",
        "type": "ParameterValue",
        "binding": "same_object_as:target_parameter",
        "required": false,
        "desc": "target_parameter 的当前值；仍依赖明确保留的参数时是开放 Symbol 状态。 目标系数仍依赖明确保留的参数时为 open_state；不存在自由符号时为 closed_state。",
        "return_expectation_policy": "selectable",
        "possible_forms": [
          "open_state",
          "closed_state"
        ]
      }
    ],
    "do_not_use_when": [
      "当前目标所需的同一抛物线状态已经由前序调用完整确定，无需用相同约束重复求解。",
      "不能根据下游Goal希望求哪个参数来选择或缩减free_parameters；它必须是当前scope约束后完整的独立基底。runtime可证明等价的基底均合法。",
      "要求 closed_state 时，不能遗漏当前抛物线仍含自由符号对应的 parameter_value；代码只会在 Symbol 身份唯一时确定性补全。",
      "不要把参数范围或不等式放入 extra_equation；它只接受用于求系数的等式。",
      "不要把同一个 Symbol 同时声明为 free_parameters 和 target_parameter。",
      "题面 Function 模板已有多个已知系数时，不要逐个调用 evaluate_expression_at_parameter；使用 known_coefficients 一次建立当前 Parabola 状态。",
      "目标只是把已求出的参数值代回同一题面抛物线时，继续使用该Function的SourceRef；编译器会读取当前scope最近可见的Parabola状态和参数值。不要用StepResultRef指定具名Function的普通状态，也不要再次建立抛物线。",
      "不要添加quadratic、parabola、x或all_coefficients参数；这些内部输入由编译器从当前scope的题面权威中注入，且不属于公开args。",
      "新增曲线点或方程代入后成为恒等式，或只约束其他符号，却仍指定一个未出现在这些约束中的 target_parameter；该能力不能凭目标名称反求系数。"
    ],
    "input_requirements": [
      {
        "requirement": "free_parameters、target_parameter 必须引用彼此不同的语义状态。"
      }
    ]
  },

        "role": "零个或多个已知坐标的曲线点；每个点都会作为独立曲线约束。"
      },
      {
        "name": "free_parameters",
        "domain_type": "Symbol",
        "required": false,
        "cardinality": "many",
        "role": "应用当前scope约束后仍未确定的一组完整独立参数基底。开放状态必须填写非空基底；闭合状态可填写[]或省略。可使用runtime可证明等价的任一基底，不得按下游Goal目标人为收窄。"
      },
      {
        "name": "parameter_value",
        "domain_type": "Symbol",
        "required": false,
        "cardinality": "one",
        "role": "单个需要代入当前抛物线状态的已求参数值。它不是多个已知系数的容器；多个系数请使用 known_coefficients。"
      },
      {
        "name": "target_parameter",
        "domain_type": "Symbol",
        "required": false,
        "cardinality": "one",
        "role": "本轮希望明确求出的二次函数系数。"
      }
    ],
    "returns": [
      {
        "name": "coefficients",
        "type": "Coefficients",
        "binding": "call_result_or_answer_or_existing_object",
        "value_cardinality": "aggregate",
        "desc": "返回值是一个整体的 Coefficients 聚合值，不是单个对象。若绑定 required answer，必须使用 answer 类型的 binding 且 value_type=Coefficients；不得绑定为单个对象。"
      },
      {
        "name": "parabola",
        "type": "Parabola",
        "binding": "same_compiler_selected_object",
        "desc": "抛物线状态仍含未确定系数或参数时为 open_state；不存在自由符号时为 closed_state。代码以 runtime 表达式的自由符号为准。 对象身份由编译器从当前scope的题面权威中选择；不要为此添加catalog未声明的输入参数。",
        "return_expectation_policy": "selectable",
        "possible_forms": [
          "open_state",
          "closed_state"
        ]
      },
      {
        "name": "parameter_value",
        "type": "ParameterValue",
        "binding": "same_object_as:target_parameter",
        "required": false,
        "desc": "target_parameter 的当前值；仍依赖明确保留的参数时是开放 Symbol 状态。 目标系数仍依赖明确保留的参数时为 open_state；不存在自由符号时为 closed_state。",
        "return_expectation_policy": "selectable",
        "possible_forms": [
          "open_state",
          "closed_state"
        ]
      }
    ],
    "do_not_use_when": [
      "当前目标所需的同一抛物线状态已经由前序调用完整确定，无需用相同约束重复求解。",
      "不能根据下游Goal希望求哪个参数来选择或缩减free_parameters；它必须是当前scope约束后完整的独立基底。runtime可证明等价的基底均合法。",
      "要求 closed_state 时，不能遗漏当前抛物线仍含自由符号对应的 parameter_value；代码只会在 Symbol 身份唯一时确定性补全。",
      "不要把参数范围或不等式放入 extra_equation；它只接受用于求系数的等式。",
      "不要把同一个 Symbol 同时声明为 free_parameters 和 target_parameter。",
      "题面 Function 模板已有多个已知系数时，不要逐个调用 evaluate_expression_at_parameter；使用 known_coefficients 一次建立当前 Parabola 状态。",
      "目标只是把已求出的参数值代回同一题面抛物线时，继续使用该Function的SourceRef；编译器会读取当前scope最近可见的Parabola状态和参数值。不要用StepResultRef指定具名Function的普通状态，也不要再次建立抛物线。",
      "不要添加quadratic、parabola、x或all_coefficients参数；这些内部输入由编译器从当前scope的题面权威中注入，且不属于公开args。",
      "新增曲线点或方程代入后成为恒等式，或只约束其他符号，却仍指定一个未出现在这些约束中的 target_parameter；该能力不能凭目标名称反求系数。"
    ],
    "input_requirements": [
      {
        "requirement": "free_parameters、target_parameter 必须引用彼此不同的语义状态。"
      }
    ]
  },

Method / Recipe Spec
{
  "method_id": "quadratic_from_constraints",
  "title": "由二次函数约束求抛物线",
  "description": "由编译器选择当前scope的题面二次函数身份与可见状态，Plan只提交当前scope新增的已知系数、曲线点、系数关系和额外方程，求该scope约束下的最简抛物线。应用本步骤当前scope约束后，free_parameters必须给出仍未确定状态的一组完整独立参数基底；开放状态必须非空，闭合状态允许[]或省略。runtime可证明等价的基底均可使用，但不能根据下游Goal提前收窄。兄弟scope使用不同局部条件时，应在各自scope分别生成状态。",
  "summary": "根据当前scope中由编译器注入的唯一题面二次函数身份与可见状态，联立本步骤新增的已知系数、系数关系、曲线点、等式或参数值，输出最简系数与抛物线。Plan只填写catalog公开的约束参数；quadratic、parabola、x和all_coefficients均由编译器确定，不得自行放入args。指定target_parameter时还可输出该系数关于free_parameters的开放或闭合状态。使用原则：多个已知系数应一次放入 known_coefficients；单个运行参数代入才使用parameter_value；free_parameters必须给出应用本步骤当前scope约束后的一组完整独立参数基底：开放状态必填非空，闭合状态可填[]或省略。",
  "solves": [
    "derive_quadratic_from_constraints"
  ],
  "inputs": {
    "quadratic": {
      "required": true,
      "domain_type": "QuadraticFunction",
      "runtime_type": "Expression",
      "view": {
        "mode": "latest_state",
        "domain_type": "QuadraticFunction",
        "object_kind": "function",
        "state_kind": "expression"
      }
    },
    "quadratic_template": {
      "required": false,
      "functional_exposed": false,
      "description": "由MethodInputReadAuthority注入同一二次函数对象的ordinal-0原始系数模板；不得使用已消元的latest state代替。",
      "domain_type": "QuadraticFunction",
      "runtime_type": "Expression",
      "view": {
        "mode": "immutable_value",
        "domain_type": "QuadraticFunction",
        "object_kind": "function",
        "state_kind": "expression"
      },
      "binding": {
        "schema_version": "method-input-binding/v1",
        "input_name": "quadratic_template",
        "required": false,
        "derivation": {
          "kind": "ordinal_zero_template",
          "source_input": "quadratic"
        }
      }
    },
    "x": {
      "required": true,
      "domain_type": "Symbol",
      "runtime_type": "Symbol",
      "view": {
        "mode": "identity",
        "domain_type": "Symbol",
        "object_kind": "symbol",
        "state_kind": "value"
      },
      "binding": {
        "schema_version": "method-input-binding/v1",
        "input_name": "x",
        "required": true,
        "derivation": {
          "kind": "canonical_symbol",
          "symbol_name": "x"
        }
      }
    },
    "all_coefficients": {
      "required": true,
      "domain_type": "SymbolList",
      "runtime_type": "SymbolList",
      "view": {
        "mode": "immutable_value",
        "domain_type": "SymbolList"
      }
    },
    "known_coefficients": {
      "required": false,
      "description": "当前scope可见的零个或多个 symbol_value Fact；每个Fact提供一个已知二次函数系数值。",
      "domain_type": "Coefficients",
      "runtime_type": "Coefficients",
      "view": {
        "mode": "immutable_value",
        "domain_type": "Coefficients"
      }
    },
    "coefficient_relation": {
      "required": false,
      "domain_type": "Fact",
      "runtime_type": "Equation",
      "view": {
        "mode": "immutable_value",
        "domain_type": "Fact"
      }
    },
    "extra_equation": {
      "required": false,
      "domain_type": "Fact",
      "runtime_type": "Equation",
      "view": {
        "mode": "immutable_value",
        "domain_type": "Fact"
      }
    },
    "curve_point": {
      "required": false,
      "domain_type": "Point",
      "runtime_type": "Point",
      "view": {
        "mode": "latest_state",
        "domain_type": "Point",
        "object_kind": "point",
        "state_kind": "coordinate"
      }
    },
    "curve_points": {
      "required": false,
      "domain_type": "PointList",
      "runtime_type": "PointList",
      "view": {
        "mode": "latest_state",
        "domain_type": "PointList",
        "object_kind": "point",
        "state_kind": "coordinate"
      }

        "∴",
        "代入 N 点坐标，得 1－m＝4a＋2b＋c"
      ],
      [
        "计算",
        "联立上述方程，得 a＝1/(m－2)，b＝－2/(m－2)，c＝1－m"
      ],
      [
        "∴",
        "y＝(1/(m－2))x²－2/(m－2)x＋1－m"
      ]
    ],
    "box": [
      "y＝(1/(m－2))x²－2/(m－2)x＋1－m"
    ],
    "unit_key": "quadratic_from_constraints/derive_function"
  }
]

quadratic_square_path_minimum macro · QuadraticSquareReflectionPathMinimumSolver

公开合同与通用 Spec

coverage complete
Teaching: explicit · Visual: explicit

Public contract
{
  "QuadraticSquareReflectionPathMinimumSolver": {
    "capability_id": "quadratic_square_path_minimum",
    "title": "二次函数正方形路径最值",
    "use_when": "当二次函数确定正方形相关点的参数化状态，且题面路径可由正方形的中点、中心和旋转关系降为单动点直线轨迹时，原子地求出最小值表达式和取等号时的降维后正方形动点。Planner 只选择当前抛物线、路径目标和正方形；相关中点、中心、轴成员关系及几何角色由代码解析并验证。attainment_point 的对象身份也由代码绑定，不是当前 Goal 的最终答案点；后续应通过 StepResultRef 消费，不要为它设置 output_targets。",
    "args": [
      {
        "name": "parabola",
        "domain_type": "QuadraticFunction",
        "required": true,
        "cardinality": "one",
        "role": "读取当前函数对象已计算出的抛物线状态。允许 closed_state，或只依赖一个独立自由参数的 open_state；题面 Function 模板仅在代码能由可见系数值确定性物化到该边界时可直接引用。"
      },
      {
        "name": "path_minimum_target",
        "domain_type": "Fact",
        "required": true,
        "cardinality": "one",
        "fact_types": [
          "path_minimum_target"
        ]
      },
      {
        "name": "square",
        "domain_type": "Fact",
        "required": true,
        "cardinality": "one",
        "fact_types": [
          "square"
        ]
      }
    ],
    "returns": [
      {
        "name": "minimum_expression",
        "type": "MinimumExpression",
        "binding": "call_result_or_answer_or_existing_object",
        "desc": "仍依赖二次函数主参数时为 open_expression；参数已确定且表达式无自由符号时为 closed_value。",
        "return_expectation_policy": "selectable",
        "possible_forms": [
          "open_expression",
          "closed_value"
        ]
      },
      {
        "name": "attainment_point",
        "type": "Point",
        "binding": "exact_call_result_or_answer",
        "reference_mode": "exact_result",
        "desc": "正方形关系降维后唯一动点的取等坐标；对象身份由代码从结构化路径和正方形中解析。不要把它绑定为当前 Goal 的最终答案点，后续直接用 StepResultRef 消费。 坐标仍含未确定符号时为 open_state；不存在自由符号时为 closed_state。重复写入同一对象时，代码会验证它是否为状态收敛。",
        "return_expectation_policy": "selectable",
        "possible_forms": [
          "open_state",
          "closed_state"
        ]
      }
    ],
    "do_not_use_when": [
      "正方形不参与路径降维或轨迹传播。",
      "路径含有无法消除的两个独立动点。",
      "有效动点轨迹不是直线，或目标是加权距离。",
      "当前函数状态不是二次函数。"
    ]
  }
}

    "nav_title": "化简路径",
    "title": "利用正方形关系化简路径",
    "goal": "用中点、中心和正方形等长关系，把原路径化为单动点路径。",
    "derive": [
      [
        "∵",
        "FM=AE/2，HF=AG/2，AE=AG"
      ],
      [
        "∴",
        "HF+FM=AG"
      ],
      [
        "∴",
        "HF+FM+MG＝AG+MG"
      ]
    ],
    "box": [
      "HF+FM+MG＝AG+MG"
    ],
    "unit_key": "quadratic_square_path_minimum/path_reduction"
  },
  {
    "nav_title": "轨迹与反射",
    "title": "确定G的轨迹并用反射求最短路径",
    "goal": "确定动点轨迹，构造对称点拉直折线，并给出最小值与取等位置。",
    "derive": [
      [
        "∵",
        "G 的轨迹为 y=-c/2-1/2"
      ],
      [
        "作",
        "关于该轨迹构造 A′(-c,-c-1)"
      ],
      [
        "∵",
        "AG=A′G"
      ],
      [
        "∴",
        "AG+MG＝A′G+MG≥A′M"
      ],
      [
        "∴",
        "最小值为 √5|c+1|/2"
      ],
      [
        "∴",
        "在 G(1/4-3c/4,-c/2-1/2) 处取得"
      ]

{
  "method_id": "right_angle_equal_length_candidates",

        "state_kind": "coordinate"
      }
    },

Public contract
{
  "QuadraticPathMinimumSolver": {
    "capability_id": "right_angle_equal_length_construct_and_select",
    "title": "直角等腰构造并筛选点",
    "use_when": "由直角等腰/旋转关系先列出候选点，再结合象限、参数范围或曲线条件筛选出符合题设的点。",
    "args": [
      {
        "name": "right_angle_equal_length",
        "domain_type": "Fact",
        "required": true,
        "cardinality": "one",
        "fact_types": [
          "right_angle_equal_length"
        ]
      }
    ],
    "returns": [
      {
        "name": "selected_target_point",
        "type": "Point",
        "binding": "call_result_or_answer_or_existing_object",
        "desc": "坐标仍含未确定符号时为 open_state；不存在自由符号时为 closed_state。重复写入同一对象时，代码会验证它是否为状态收敛。",
        "return_expectation_policy": "selectable",
        "possible_forms": [
          "open_state",
          "closed_state"
        ]
      }
    ],
    "do_not_use_when": [
      "只有直角或等长中的单个条件，无法确定构造点所需的完整对象角色和约束。",
      "只有完整直角等长关系、曲线归属和参数正负条件，但没有明确的象限、方向或唯一几何筛选条件；此时应先列出全部几何候选，再使用曲线和参数条件筛选，不能假定默认旋转方向。"
    ]
  },
  "QuadraticWeightedPathMinimumSolver": {
    "capability_id": "right_angle_equal_length_construct_and_select",
    "title": "直角等腰构造并筛选点",
    "use_when": "仅在直角等腰关系之外，还存在能够直接唯一选择旋转分支的象限、方向或同类几何筛选条件时，生成候选并立即选出目标点。若分支只能通过“点在曲线上”和参数正负条件确定，应使用候选生成能力后再进行曲线筛选。",
    "args": [
      {
        "name": "right_angle_equal_length",
        "domain_type": "Fact",
        "required": true,
        "cardinality": "one",
        "fact_types": [
          "right_angle_equal_length"
        ]
      }
    ],
    "returns": [
      {
        "name": "selected_target_point",
        "type": "Point",
        "binding": "call_result_or_answer_or_existing_object",
        "desc": "坐标仍含未确定符号时为 open_state；不存在自由符号时为 closed_state。重复写入同一对象时，代码会验证它是否为状态收敛。",
        "return_expectation_policy": "selectable",
        "possible_forms": [
          "open_state",
          "closed_state"
        ]
      }
    ],
    "do_not_use_when": [
      "只有直角或等长中的单个条件，无法确定构造点所需的完整对象角色和约束。",
      "只有完整直角等长关系、曲线归属和参数正负条件，但没有明确的象限、方向或唯一几何筛选条件；此时应先列出全部几何候选，再使用曲线和参数条件筛选，不能假定默认旋转方向。"
    ]
  }
}

  "recipe_id": "right_angle_equal_length_construct_and_select",
  "title": "直角等腰构造并筛选点",

    "derive": [
      [
        "设",
        "两个候选点分别为N₁、N₂"
      ],
      [
        "作",
        "MU⊥x 轴于U，N₁V⊥x 轴于V，N₂W⊥x 轴于W"
      ],
      [
        "∵",
        "D(1,0)，M(m,1)"
      ],
      [
        "∴",
        "U(m,0)，DU＝m－1，MU＝1"
      ],
      [
        "∵",
        "∠MDN₁＝∠MDN₂＝90°，DM＝DN₁＝DN₂"
      ],
      [
        "∴",
        "Rt△DUM≌Rt△N₁VD≌Rt△N₂WD"
      ],
      [
        "∴",
        "DV＝DW＝MU＝1，N₁V＝N₂W＝DU＝m－1"
      ],
      [

square_adjacent_vertex_from_side function · QuadraticSquareReflectionPathMinimumSolver

公开合同与通用 Spec

coverage complete
Teaching: explicit · Visual: explicit

Public contract
{
  "QuadraticSquareReflectionPathMinimumSolver": {
    "capability_id": "square_adjacent_vertex_from_side",
    "title": "由正方形边求相邻顶点",
    "use_when": "由正方形一条已知边的两个已计算端点、顶点顺序和方向条件，求指定相邻顶点的坐标表达式。必须通过公开返回角色 adjacent_vertex 明确绑定本次要计算的正方形顶点；代码用该对象在 ordered vertices 中的角色确定旋转方向，不会在多个剩余顶点之间猜测。该能力只做 90° 旋转构造，不负责把顶点代入曲线求参数。",
    "args": [
      {
        "name": "side_start",
        "domain_type": "Point",
        "required": true,
        "cardinality": "one"
      },
      {
        "name": "side_end",
        "domain_type": "Point",
        "required": true,
        "cardinality": "one"
      },
      {
        "name": "square",
        "domain_type": "Fact",
        "required": true,
        "cardinality": "one",
        "fact_types": [
          "square"
        ]
      },
      {
        "name": "parameter_value",
        "domain_type": "Symbol",
        "required": false,
        "cardinality": "one"
      }
    ],
    "returns": [
      {
        "name": "adjacent_vertex",
        "type": "Point",
        "binding": "explicit_answer_or_existing_object",
        "desc": "由正方形的一条有向边恢复相邻顶点；返回必须绑定本次实际求出的题面对象。 坐标仍含未确定符号时为 open_state；不存在自由符号时为 closed_state。重复写入同一对象时，代码会验证它是否为状态收敛。",
        "return_expectation_policy": "selectable",
        "possible_forms": [
          "open_state",
          "closed_state"
        ]
      }
    ],
    "do_not_use_when": [
      "已知边任一端点只有对象引用而没有坐标状态。",
      "目标是求当前边端点本身，而不是由这条边旋转得到的相邻顶点。",
      "正方形关系中仍有多个合法候选顶点，但没有通过公开返回角色 adjacent_vertex 明确绑定本次要计算的对象。",
      "side_start 或 side_end 来自前序 call，但该返回没有绑定到正方形中对应的已有顶点对象；call-local Point 不能代替 ordered vertices 中的对象身份。"
    ]
  }
}

    "square_condition 包含 ordered vertices；side_start、side_end 和绑定的目标点都必须对应其中的明确顶点角色",
    "若方向不能由 ordered vertices 唯一确定，则需要可判定的 orientation 或参数范围约束"
  ],
  "do_not_use_when": [
    "已知边任一端点只有对象引用而没有坐标状态。",
    "目标是求当前边端点本身，而不是由这条边旋转得到的相邻顶点。",
    "正方形关系中仍有多个合法候选顶点，但没有通过公开返回角色 adjacent_vertex 明确绑定本次要计算的对象。",
    "side_start 或 side_end 来自前序 call，但该返回没有绑定到正方形中对应的已有顶点对象；call-local Point 不能代替 ordered vertices 中的对象身份。"
  ],
  "postconditions": [
    "输出对象就是公开返回角色 adjacent_vertex 绑定的正方形顶点",
    "输出顶点与给定边构成垂直等长的正方形相邻边"
  ],

        "binding_selector:square:side_end"

      "message": "正方形边端点绑定失败；通常不需要新增 segment，系统可从已求点坐标 fact/answer 绑定正方形边端点。",
      "next_actions": [

      ],
      "do_not": [

        "不要新增只计算端点坐标的临时 utility step。"
      ]
    }

weighted_axis_path_minimum macro · QuadraticWeightedPathMinimumSolver

公开合同与通用 Spec

coverage complete
Teaching: explicit · Visual: explicit

Public contract
{
  "QuadraticWeightedPathMinimumSolver": {
    "capability_id": "weighted_axis_path_minimum",
    "title": "加权轴上路径最值",
    "use_when": "当路径目标恰由一个非单位权重线段和一个普通线段组成、两项共享同一轴上动点，且加权端点已有单参数坐标状态时，原子完成辅助三角形、轨迹、折线拉直、合法域和取等可达性验证。Planner 只选择完整的 path_minimum_target；曲线端点、轴上固定端点、动点、两个参数及其定义域全部由代码从 typed path terms 和可见状态唯一解析。该 Macro 只返回最小值表达式；题设给定最小值后，继续用普通参数求解能力。",
    "args": [
      {
        "name": "path_minimum_target",
        "domain_type": "Fact",
        "required": true,
        "cardinality": "one",
        "fact_types": [
          "path_minimum_target"
        ]
      }
    ],
    "returns": [
      {
        "name": "minimum_expression",
        "type": "MinimumExpression",
        "binding": "call_result_or_answer_or_existing_object",
        "desc": "仍依赖主参数时为 open_expression；参数已确定且结果无自由符号时为 closed_value。定义域边界会由内核直接表示为 Piecewise，不增加 Planner 步骤。",
        "return_expectation_policy": "selectable",
        "possible_forms": [
          "open_expression",
          "closed_value"
        ]
      }
    ],
    "do_not_use_when": [
      "路径没有非单位权重，或两项不共享同一个轴上动点。",
      "加权系数没有登记对应的辅助三角形几何 profile。",
      "加权端点尚未物化为只含一个主参数的 Point 状态。",
      "目标需要正方形降维、两动点端点替换或等长射线构造。"
    ]
  }
}

绑定后的教学材料
[
  {
    "nav_title": "消去路径权重",
    "title": "构造辅助直角三角形消去路径权重",
    "goal": "把加权线段转化为同倍率普通线段，得到等价折线路径。",
    "derive": [
      [
        "作",
        "在 x 轴上方作等腰直角三角形 AQN，使 AQ＝QN，∠AQN＝90°"
      ],
      [
        "∵",
        "AN 是 Rt△AQN 的斜边"
      ],
      [
        "∴",
        "AN＝√2·QN"
      ],
      [
        "∴",
        "√2MN＋AN＝√2MN＋√2QN"
      ],
      [
        "∴",
        "√2MN＋AN＝√2(MN＋QN)"
      ],
      [
        "∵",
        "N 在 x 轴上运动"
      ],
      [
        "∴",
        "Q 在过 A 且经过 y 轴正半轴点 (0,1) 的 45° 固定射线 y＝x＋1 上运动"
      ]
    ],
    "box": [
      "√2MN＋AN＝√2(MN＋QN)"
    ],
    "unit_key": "weighted_axis_path_minimum/weighted_reduction"
  },
  {
    "nav_title": "几何求最值",
    "title": "拉直折线求路径最小值",
    "goal": "把普通折线拉直，由图中的最短路径直接得到最小值，并说明取等条件。",
    "derive": [
      [
        "∵",
        "两点之间线段最短"
      ],
      [
        "∴",
        "MN＋NQ≥MQ"
      ],
      [
        "∴",
        "当 M、N、Q 三点共线时，折线最短"
      ],
      [
        "∵",
        "Q 在过 A 且经过 y 轴正半轴点 (0,1) 的 45° 固定射线 y＝x＋1 上运动"
      ],
      [
        "∴",
        "最短时 MQ⊥AQ"
      ],
      [
        "∵",
        "取等时 N((2b－1)/4,0)，且 N 在 x 轴正半轴上"
      ],
      [
        "∴",
        "取等条件为 b＞1/2"
      ],
      [
        "∴",
        "此时 √2MN＋AN 的最小值为 (6b＋9)/4"
      ]
    ],
    "box": [
      "当 b＞1/2 时，最小值为 (6b＋9)/4"
    ],
    "unit_key": "weighted_axis_path_minimum/domain_minimum"
  }
]

      "goal": "把普通折线拉直，由图中的最短路径直接得到最小值，并说明取等条件。",
      "derive": [
        [
          "∵",
          "两点之间线段最短"
        ],
        [
          "∴",
          "MN＋NQ≥MQ"
        ],
        [
          "∴",
          "当 M、N、Q 三点共线时，折线最短"
        ],
        [
          "∵",
          "Q 在过 A 且经过 y 轴正半轴点 (0,1) 的 45° 固定射线 y＝x＋1 上运动"
        ],
        [
          "∴",
          "最短时 MQ⊥AQ"
        ],
        [
          "∵",
          "取等时 N((2b－1)/4,0)，且 N 在 x 轴正半轴上"
        ],
        [
          "∴",
          "取等条件为 b＞1/2"
        ],
        [
          "∴",
          "此时 √2MN＋AN 的最小值为 (6b＋9)/4"
        ]
      ],
      "box": [
        "当 b＞1/2 时，最小值为 (6b＋9)/4"
      ]
    }
  ],

绑定后的教学材料
[
  {
    "nav_title": "消去路径权重",
    "title": "构造辅助直角三角形消去路径权重",
    "goal": "把加权线段转化为同倍率普通线段，得到等价折线路径。",
    "derive": [
      [
        "作",
        "在 x 轴上方作 Rt△AQM，使 ∠AQM＝90°，∠QAM＝30°"
      ],
      [
        "∵",
        "在 Rt△AQM 中，30° 角所对的边为 QM"
      ],
      [
        "∴",
        "AM＝2·QM"
      ],
      [
        "∴",
        "2DM＋AM＝2DM＋2QM"
      ],
      [
        "∴",
        "2DM＋AM＝2(DM＋QM)"
      ],
      [
        "∵",
        "M 在 x 轴上运动"
      ],
      [
